name: Historic Monuments of Novgorod and Surroundings
description: Veliky Novgorod, in northwestern Russia, was the country's first capital in the 9th century and sat on an ancient trade route linking Central Asia with northern Europe. Its medieval churches and monasteries, many ringing the town and its surroundings, show how Russian church architecture took shape. Inside, you can see 14th-century frescoes by Theophanes the Greek, the teacher of Andrei Rublev.
